objective: Strict deterministic workspace blueprints and exact scoped plan-only provisioning receipts.
contractDecisions: Only host-validated descriptors with matching sha256 evidence can create a plan.
Demo, offline and unavailable descriptors remain explicit and non-planable.
Plan identity binds exact tenant, user, WorkspaceInstanceId, WorkspaceBlueprintId and blueprint version.
All authority fields are re-derived from the reviewed descriptor; unknown execution or success fields fail closed.
WorkspaceInstance.health is optional and independent from workspace and provisioning lifecycle.
